background.title: Background
background.description: B.Tech in Computer Science from IIIT Sri City (CGPA 8.74). Backend engineer at Cyware since Dec 2024 (intern, then Software Engineer I), building multi-tenant SaaS services in Python and Go on Kafka, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL and Kubernetes. I own work from design through rollout and production monitoring, and I measure the result: faster APIs, leaner pipelines, fewer failures.

sections.title: How I Think
sections.description: Measure before changing anything. I break a slow or flaky system into its parts, find where the time or the failures actually go, fix that, and prove the fix with before/after numbers. I write the plan down first, and I ship with metrics and alerts so the next problem shows up before a customer reports it.

sections.title: What I've Shipped
sections.description: An API cut from 4.2 s to 385 ms on a 10M-document dataset. A Kafka ingestion service that sends 6x fewer messages and 2.4x less data. A resumable data-seeding pipeline that loads 155k records with zero failed batches. Go services instrumented across 6 production clusters. An agentic AI workflow using 90% fewer LLM tokens. Plus a streaming engine reaching 955 MB/s, published at ICCCNT 2024.
